summary: Combined LPD + CUPS extensions. LPD queue-list op 03/04 (T1). LPD fingerprint gates CVE citations. IPP Get-Jobs (T1). cups-browsed 631/udp probe with a real listener callback — that is T2 ingress verification of CVE-2024-47176 without payload. /admin log-endpoint read (T1). Very comprehensive; refuses op 02 and foomatic payload delivery.

findings.title_pattern: LPD queue leaks usernames, source hostnames and print job filenames
findings.tier_evidence: RFC 1179 op 03/04 returning owner/host/filename rows requires an unauth daemon accept — deterministic.
findings.promotion_notes: Already promoted implicitly: real user + hostname + filename tuples are the loot.
findings.tester_next_step: lpq -P lp -h IP ; then feed owners into known_users, hosts into known_hostnames

findings.tier_evidence: Empty queue but daemon still answered — daemon accepts unauth queries.
findings.tester_next_step: lpq -P lp -h IP  # empty now, but leaks on the next job

findings.title_pattern: LPRng detected - CVE-2000-0917 / CVE-2001-0670 unauth RCE class
findings.tier_evidence: Text fingerprint match on LPRng banner — CVE candidate, not exploit.
findings.promotion_notes: Format-string exploit is destructive and highly OS-specific; keep detection-only.
findings.tester_next_step: review LPRng version and vendor patch date; Metasploit modules exist (aux/scanner/printer/lprng_format_string) but destructive.

findings.tier_evidence: Text fingerprint only; requires firmware-date correlation to confirm.
findings.promotion_notes: Add a PJL @PJL INFO ID probe on 9100/tcp to pull the firmware date; that's a version-gate for the CVE.
findings.tester_next_step: nmap -p9100 --script pjl-ready-message IP  ; # or: printf '@PJL INFO ID\r\n' | nc IP 9100

findings.title_pattern: Windows Print Service on 515/tcp - correlate with PrintNightmare on 445
findings.tier_evidence: LPD banner identifies Windows Print Service — recon.
findings.promotion_notes: Correlate with SMB signing + spooler posture from smb module.
findings.tester_next_step: recce smb IP  # cross-check spooler status; then rpcdump.py --print-services for MS-RPRN

findings.title_pattern: LPD daemon accepts queue commands from any peer (no /etc/hosts.lpd)
findings.tier_evidence: recce (an arbitrary peer) received a listing at all — deterministic ACL-off signal. Op 02 explicitly not invoked.
findings.promotion_notes: Op 02 control-file injection is destructive; keep detection-only.
findings.tester_next_step: review /etc/hosts.lpd on the target manually; do not send op 02 without ROE

findings.title_pattern: IPP Get-Jobs leaks originating user/host and document names
findings.tier_evidence: IPP Get-Jobs (op 0x000A) unauth returned real user/host/filename tuples.
findings.promotion_notes: Values are real loot; feeds known_users.

findings.title_pattern: cups-browsed (631/udp) accepts crafted printer URIs - CVE-2024-47176 ingress reachable
findings.tier_evidence: recce sends a browse advert for a fake IPP URI and OPENS a real TCP listener; only if the daemon actually reaches back does replied=True. That is proof-of-ingress, not merely a posture claim, and does NOT deliver the foomatic payload.
findings.promotion_notes: T3 would deliver the Get-Printer-Attributes payload with attacker-controlled foomatic filter; destructive by design. Module correctly refuses.
findings.tester_next_step: # ROE-required. PoC: cups-2024-47176 exploit scripts on public repos; recce leaves the actual payload delivery to the operator.

findings.title_pattern: CUPS reachable at vulnerable version - CVE-2024-47076/-47175/-47176/-47177 foomatic-rip chain applies
findings.tier_evidence: Version-gated. Severity upgrades to critical when cups_browsed_reachable also fires (ingress path confirmed).
findings.promotion_notes: Same as cups_browsed_reachable promotion — destructive payload delivery is out of scope.
findings.tester_next_step: See PoC scripts on public repos; run only with ROE. Verify fixed line: upstream 2.4.9+, Ubuntu 24.04.1 cups 2.4.7-1.2ubuntu7.1, RHEL 9 cups 2.3.3op2-25.

findings.title_pattern: CUPS reachable but past the 2024-09 fixed line

findings.tier_evidence: GET /admin/log/access_log or /admin/log/error_log returned HTTP 200 without auth — deterministic exposure.
findings.promotion_notes: Pull the log body to extract print-job history / user IPs; module already implies this next step.
findings.tester_next_step: curl -sS http://IP:631/admin/log/error_log | tail -200  # user + IP + filename history

findings.title_pattern: CUPS /admin endpoints require authentication (default-cred spray candidate)
findings.promotion_notes: Wire up default-cred quickconnect (cups/cups, admin/admin) explicitly.
findings.tester_next_step: curl -u cups:cups http://IP:631/admin ; hydra -l cups -P /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt http-get://IP:631/admin

findings.title_pattern: IPP printer-uri-supported discloses internal hostnames / DNS suffixes
findings.tier_evidence: URI parse from printer attributes — recon.

findings.promotion_notes: 9100 PJL analyzer is out-of-scope for this module.
findings.tester_next_step: printf '@PJL INFO ID\r\n' | nc IP 9100  ; # firmware + PJL support
